name: TACO
intro: TACO是一个开源的大规模代码生成数据集，聚焦算法与编程技能，旨在为代码生成模型提供更具挑战性的训练数据和评测基准。TACO包含竞赛级编程问题，用于增强或评估模型在真实编程场景中的问题理解与推理能力。每个问题都带有主题、算法、编程技能和难度等级等细粒度标签，为训练与评测提供更精确的依据。
build_method: 多源爬取与整合, 可执行解答验证, MinHash去重, GPT-4测试增强, 多维标注
scale: 25,443个训练问题 + 1,000个测试问题；1,539,152个验证解答
build_method_en: Multi-Source Collection, Executable-Solution Validation, MinHash Deduplication, GPT-4 Test Augmentation, Multidimensional Annotation
intro_en: TACO is an open-source, large-scale code-generation dataset focused on algorithms and programming skills. It provides challenging competition-level problems for training and evaluating problem understanding and reasoning in realistic programming scenarios. Each problem includes fine-grained topic, algorithm, skill, and difficulty labels.

drawio_review_note: Primary-source review: arXiv:2312.14852v2 §§3.1–3.2, §4, and §5.1, plus FlagOpen/TACO commit 245eba3beb2d23a07082307de303de2589e4321a. Four platforms are crawled directly; APPS, CodeContest, and Description2code are imported. Platform parsers are manually sampled, with HackerRank SVG OCR manually verified. Unit-test validation applies only to new crawls; 2to3 conversion applies only to Description2code; deduplication and AST decommenting apply to all components. MinHash/Jaccard 0.85 reduces 2,045,502 examples to 1,539,152 solutions. Test augmentation only affects the test split: GPT-4 proposes inputs, 30 verified solutions vote on outputs, and the loop reaches at least 200 tests. Labels contract from 968 to 36, including eight skills. Detailed text and tables say 25,443 training plus 1,000 test problems, while the abstract alone says 25,433. Code models use 200 seeds, top_p 0.95, and temperatures 0.2/0.6/0.8; GPT-4 uses one sample at 0.7 and Pass@1. Repository post-processing performs EOF truncation only, and metrics use the unbiased Pass@k estimator.
